Subject: FW: Club Statement from Detroit Tigers Executive Vice President of Baseball Operations and General Manager Al Avila 
 
Interesting choice of words:
decisions in any of these areas will be made by the end of the season
Doesn’t say AT the end of the season or AFTER the end of the season. BY can be whenever – such as in the past already.
Have fun today, George and Anthony (headed your way)!
Great job in the wee hours.

From: Aileen.Villarreal@detroittigers.com [mailto:Aileen.Villarreal@detroittigers.com] 
Sent: Friday, September 11, 2015 12:34 PM
Subject: Club Statement from Detroit Tigers Executive Vice President of Baseball Operations and General Manager Al Avila

FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE                                                                                                                                CONTACT: COMMUNICATIONS 
FRIDAY, SEPTEMBER 11, 2015                                                                                                                                 313-471-2000/tigers.com 
                                                                                                                                                                   @tigers/@TigresdeDetroit
                                                                                                                                                                  facebook.com/tigers
DETROIT -- The following statement is attributable to Al Avila, Detroit Tigers Executive Vice President of Baseball Operations and General Manager.

"I have stated several times since becoming Executive Vice President of Baseball Operations and General Manager that we are evaluating all personnel, and know that includes the players, the manager and his staff, and minor league operations. In fact, I reconfirmed with Mr. Ilitch and Manager Brad Ausmus this morning that these evaluations are on-going and decisions in any of these areas will be made by the end of the season.”

Aileen Villarreal  |  Director, Media Relations  |  Detroit Tigers
